title.zh: Copilot Studio 三大执行内核与流程资产选型象限（THR964）
title.en: Copilot Studio Three Harnesses & Process Asset Selection Quadrant (THR964)

subtitle.zh: 依据 April Dunnam 选型矩阵：按业务推理复杂度与步骤确定性诉求匹配三大内核及混合工作流
subtitle.en: Mapped from April Dunnam's THR964 framework across multi-step reasoning complexity and procedural determinism

xAxis.zh: 开放意图拆解与异常自愈推理复杂度 (0 → 100)
xAxis.en: Open-Ended Goal Decomposition & Error Recovery Complexity (0 → 100)

yAxis.zh: 执行边界受控度、词元效率与可评测性 (0 → 100)

topLeft.zh: 固定规则与对话升级区（确定性话题/语音路由）

topRight.zh: 复杂目标推理与刚柔并济靶心（Copilot Harness）

bottomLeft.zh: 超长指令全量硬塞（上下文膨胀与漏判风险）

bottomRight.zh: 缺乏范围护栏的全网裸搜原型（越界风险）

label.zh: 在旧版硬塞复杂排障与换机复合流
label.en: Forcing Compound IT Flows into Monolithic Prompts

detail.zh: 每轮全量吞入排障规程耗费词元，面对蓝屏+换机双诉求漏判设备选项
detail.en: Ingests all instructions every turn and misses compound laptop requests

label.zh: 保留默认全网搜索与全量写权限原型
label.en: Default All-Web Search & Unscoped Write Prototype

detail.zh: 未关闭全网检索且未收紧 Work IQ 子域权限，易引入非官方排障步骤
detail.en: Leaves public web search open without domain allowlists or Work IQ scoping

detail.zh: 预先编排触发词与分支，适合固定核验步骤的密码重置
detail.en: Pre-scripted topics ideal for fixed-step password resets

label.zh: Customer Conversation Harness（对客会话内核）

detail.zh: 针对网页聊天与电话语音客服深度调优，内置平滑转人工升级链路
detail.en: Optimized for contact-center voice and web chat with human escalation

detail.zh: 按需加载最多 50 项技能、内置 Python 沙盒与 82% 基准单测闭环
detail.en: Loads up to 50 skills on demand with Python sandbox & Evaluate unit tests
